---
title: Business templates
description: Product brief, problem, users, value proposition, business rules, constraints and glossary for new projects.
---

The **business** templates capture the intent of a new project. They are generated by
[`kaddo bootstrap`](/commands/bootstrap/) under `architecture/business/` and refined with
the `business-agent`. Kaddo never invents business facts — these ship with `TBD`,
assumptions and open questions.

| Template | Purpose | Output path | Command | Agent |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Product Brief | The product in one page | `architecture/business/product-brief.md` | `kaddo bootstrap` | `business-agent` |
| Problem Statement | The problem, without assuming the solution | `architecture/business/problem.md` | `kaddo bootstrap` | `business-agent` |
| Users & Personas | Primary/secondary users with goals | `architecture/business/users.md` | `kaddo bootstrap` | `business-agent` |
| Value Proposition | For whom, what, why better | `architecture/business/value-proposition.md` | `kaddo bootstrap` | `business-agent` |
| Business Rules | Product rules as testable statements | `architecture/business/business-rules.md` | `kaddo bootstrap` | `business-agent` |
| Constraints | Business, regulatory and resource limits | `architecture/business/constraints.md` | `kaddo bootstrap` | `business-agent` |
| Glossary | Shared project vocabulary | `architecture/business/glossary.md` | `kaddo bootstrap` | `business-agent` |

Each template carries minimal sections plus **Assumptions**, **Open questions** and a
**Quality checklist**, so the knowledge is honest about what is not yet known.

These business templates feed the bootstrap layers
**Business → Architecture → Codebase → Development** alongside the
[`quality-attributes`](/templates/architecture/), [`codebase-foundation`](/templates/architecture/)
and `bootstrap-summary` templates.
